Tier **opus**, derived live (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` → *"no path-derived mandate"*), from a worktree pinned at `origin/main` `cea8c7d8`.

## Why this one is dispatched ahead of older cards in the queue

Because the clause does not go quiet — it **inverts**. A runner following it today observes the *correct* 403 on the federation spelling and scores it as a deviation, and the text pre-empts the escape hatch by naming the old behaviour *"a DELIBERATE, pinned divergence (#9593), not a hole to file"*. The two realistic outcomes are a QA run filing a regression against a landed **security tightening**, or someone acting on the clause and **loosening the gate back**. Stale prose that says nothing costs a reader some time; stale prose that says the opposite costs a security fix.

## ⛔ Zone 1

1. **Branch from `origin/main`, never bare `main`** — the shared checkout's local ref is ~120 commits stale and CLAUDE.md's recipe names it:
   `git fetch origin main && git worktree add /home/user/objectstack-issue-11138 -b claude/issue-11138-federation-capability-clause origin/main && cd /home/user/objectstack-issue-11138 && pnpm install`
2. **All four texts, not the loudest one.** `:1182` (step), `:1210` (acceptance clause), `:1232` (oracle, **including its stale line anchors** `:26-28, :215-260`), and `:63` of the item (verify text). A correction that fixes three of four leaves the contradiction live and makes the next reader trust the survivor.
3. **The gate enforces its own bookkeeping**: a clause edit owes a `revision` bump **and** a `history` entry carrying a `ref`. `check:platform-checklist` checks that presence, so a missing entry is a red you will find late.
4. ⛔ Never `git stash`; ⛔ never `pkill -f` / kill by process name; ⛔ never force-push or push `main`; ⛔ never edit `content/docs/releases/`.

## ⚠️ Zone 2 — falsify, don't inherit

- **Everything in this card is anchored at `afe1c4e0a` (08-22).** Re-verify at head: that all five routes still run one gate (reads on `manage_platform_settings`, writes on `manage_metadata`, both above the anonymous 401 floor), and that the two pinning suites still pass. The card cites `21/21` with *"an ablation of the capability arm reddens 7 of those 21, including both twin-equivalence cases"* — that is the evidence the new clause text will assert, so it has to be true **today**, not on 08-22.
- **Line numbers will have drifted.** Locate all four texts by content, never by the quoted line. (A composed regex told me a file was deleted earlier tonight because it was anchored one suffix too tight — list and read, don't pattern-match blind.)
- **The companion is a "confirm, don't assume", and the card says so.** `cli.json` item `cli.datasource-introspect-codegen` drives `os datasource list-tables` / `introspect` against the federation door, which now requires `manage_platform_settings`; its fixture line names a plain `--token` without stating the capability. Read it in the same pass and **report what you found** — if it needs the persona spelled out, do it; if it does not, say why. ⚠️ `cli.json` was edited earlier today by PR #11524 (`cd932772`), so read it at head.
- ⛔ Do **not** touch `packages/rest/**` or the two pinning test suites. This card is checklist text. If you find head's behaviour disagrees with what the card says head does, **stop and report** — that would mean the security posture is not what either text claims, and it is not this card's job to decide which is right.

## Bar for done

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green, quoted from its own verdict line. ⚠️ That gate was **red on `main` earlier today** (#11421, fixed by PR #11524 and verified both ways: exit 1 → exit 0), so a green here is meaningful only if you also confirm it is green on your base *before* your edit — otherwise you cannot tell your change from someone else's.
- Show the four texts before and after, and the `revision`/`history` bookkeeping.
- Run the derived gate union. Shared lock is contended: `exit 99` / `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` = **NOT MEASURED**, never green; declare the narrowing and proceed. ⛔ Never end your turn parked in the lock queue.

Open a **draft** PR with `Fixes #11138`. Return the structured JSON report.

## ACCEPT — PR #11582

Review by the dispatching PM seat (`session_015ahemw8RcTgqtxrj15PEZx`).

### Verified by content

| | `origin/main` | branch |
|---|---:|---:|
| `integration-system.json` — `"federation spelling serves"` | **2** | **0** |
| `integration-system.json` — `#11138` history ref | 0 | **1** |
| `integration-system.json` — `manage_platform_settings` | 4 | **8** |
| `cli.json` — `#11138` history ref | 0 | **1** |
| `cli.json` — `manage_platform_settings` | **0** | **4** |

That last row is the companion answered rather than assumed: the persona genuinely was absent.

### The premise held, and the stop-condition was checked rather than skipped

Re-verified at base `0320a52d`: all five routes open with `refuseFederationRequest`, reads on `FEDERATION_READ_CAPABILITY = 'manage_platform_settings'` (`:157`), writes on `FEDERATION_WRITE_CAPABILITY = 'manage_metadata'` (`:172`), both above the `shouldDenyAnonymous` 401 floor (`:302`). So **head disagrees with the checklist, not with the card** — Zone 1 rule 4's stop-and-report condition did not fire, and it was evaluated rather than ignored.

The stale `:26-28, :215-260` anchors are replaced with re-derived ones (`:409-448` twin family, `:287-324` `refuseFederationRequest`, `:157` + `:172`).

### ⭐ Four texts asked for, six found — and one deliberately left alone

I ruled "all four, not the loudest one". The dev found **two more in the same defect class** and named them with evidence rather than leaving them live: `personas[0]` (*"the admin spelling's capability gate"* → both spellings) and `steps[6]` (admission-case list realigned to the describe's actual name at head).

And the discipline that matters more: sibling `source[0]` (`admin-routes.ts`) was checked the **same way** and found **accurate at head**, so it was left untouched. `automated.ref` already names the suite where the new clause's pin lives — untouched too. Correcting what is wrong and leaving what is right is harder than a sweep, and it is what keeps the next reader able to trust the file.

### ⭐ The number it refused to assert

The card offers *"an ablation of the capability arm reddens 7 of those 21"* and I quoted it as the evidence the new clause would rest on. The dev did not use it:

> an ablation would require mutating `packages/rest/**`, which Zone 1 rule 4 forbids

So the new clause rests instead on what *was* measured at head — the route source, the twin suite's describe name and its two `[#9901]` unentitled cases, and a re-run showing **21/21** (matching the card exactly). **Refusing to assert a figure it could not measure without breaking a ⛔ is the right call**, and stating that explicitly is better than quietly inheriting the card's number. My dispatch put both instructions in and did not notice they collided; the dev did.

### The #11421 trap, handled exactly as asked

I warned that a green `check:platform-checklist` means nothing unless the base is also green, since that gate was red on `main` earlier today. Measured both:

```
base 0320a52d, UNMODIFIED : exit 0 — OK — 15 areas, 207 items (207 active); 31 kinds mapped, 0 waived; traps 19/19
after the edit            : exit 0 — identical verdict line
```

Attributable. Also ran two families the **derived** union named that my dispatch word did not (`check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`) — deriving instead of trusting my list is the correct instinct, and it is how the `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`-on-unbuilt-closure case got caught and correctly classified as a prerequisite rather than a finding (which is #11557's shape, filed earlier tonight).

Both edits applied by a script that **asserts each anchor matches exactly once and aborts on a zero-hit anchor**, with landing proven on disk by per-string grep counts: 6×1 injected, 5×0 deleted — and the sixth deleted string surviving *only inside the new history entry that quotes it*, noticed and explained rather than reported as a clean 6×0. That is the difference between a count and a measurement.

Both items take `revision` 1 → 2 with a history entry carrying `"ref": "#11138"`.

**Landing:** not a governed surface — ordinary path once every check is green.
